description: The bar chart, labeled "Figure 2: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset," illustrates the impact of removing specific components on the performance of a recommendation system, as measured by Recall@10. The horizontal axis lists four categories: "Ours," "Ours - critiquing," "Ours - scoring," and "Ours - ranking," representing different configurations of the system. The vertical axis is labeled "Recall@10" and ranges from 0 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1. The bars are colored in shades of blue, with "Ours" being the darkest and the others progressively lighter. The bar for "Ours" has a value of approximately 0.36, while the bars for "Ours - critiquing," "Ours - scoring," and "Ours - ranking" have values of around 0.32, 0.25, and 0.35, respectively. The bars are grouped by category, with each group consisting of a single bar. The chart is not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The figure caption explains that "critiquing" refers to attribute-based item critiquing, "scoring" refers to generative item scoring, and "ranking" refers to efficient candidate ranking.
